question: Who among the following was appointed as the director-general in the Directorate General of Civil Aviation in February 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Dev Dutt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vikram Dev Dutt** was appointed as the **Director-General in the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)** in February 2023.
 
• He is a **1993-batch IAS officer** of the Arunachal Pradesh-Goa-Mizoram and Union Territories (AGMUT) cadre.
